site.name: Annabelle Mine
site.componentDetail: Named historic silver-mine locality shown on the USGS Creede topographic map
overview: Annabelle Mine is a named historic silver-mine locality in Mineral County near Creede. The USGS Creede topographic map labels the mine, and mineral-location data place the identification point at approximately 37.85000, -106.92530.

Available sources support the mine's identity and mapped location but do not provide enough reliable mine-specific history for a fuller narrative. The point should be treated as a historic locality reference, not confirmation of a safe or accessible surviving opening.
Historic mine sites may be unstable, privately controlled, reclaimed, or otherwise unsafe. Respect closures and property boundaries and do not enter mine workings.
